text: NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY KARNATAKA SURATHKAL CAREER DEVELOPMENT CENTRE 14 Aug, 2025 Sub: Scholarships under Boeing CSR Grants-reg. *** We are happy to announce that M/s Boeing has instituted scholarships of USD 1200.00 (for UG & PG III year B Tech. and PG) for the academic year 202 5-26 under Boeing Global Engagement with universities for Students. The vacancies are as follows: Category Vacancies UG 4 PG 4 PWD 2 The award of scholarships is for all eligible NITK students, based on 1. Merit in academics (X, XII, CGPA up to VI Sem for B Tech/ (X, XII, Graduation CGPA and CGPA of I Sem for M Tech) and achievements in Co-curricular and Extracurricular events. Note: Students with 7.0 (70%) CGPA in X and XII and 7.5 CGPA and above in B Tech/M Tech are only eligible to apply. 2. One page report on any project / mini project carried out by the student that has relevance to Aerospace industry. 3. One page report on recent developments in Aerospace industry and achievements of Boeing 4. One Page write up on what the student wants to contribute to Aerospace industry 5. PWD/Income certificate (For EWS). This is mandatory. One Govt. ID Proof. The selected students should be willing to act as NITK Ambassador for Boeing to organize 3 technical (of one day duration) events at NITK during Jun – December 2025. Interested eligible students from Mechanical Engineering / all circuit branch students may apply by submitting their detailed CV with all self-attested supporting documents and items listed in Sl. No 2, 3, 4 & 5 from 18 Aug, 2025 to 25 Aug, 2025 05:00 PM TO THE CDC OFFICE. Prof. Arun M.
